issues.description: The problem statement specifies the build_msd_circ function should accept y_states as a tuple[int], but both the template and the solution declare the parameter as list[int]. This type annotation mismatch between the specification and the provided code may confuse students about the expected input container type and the tests' expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type annotation for the y_states parameter consistent across the problem statement, template, and solution. Prefer using list[int] in the problem description (or change the template/solution to tuple[int]) and update the function signature in problem_statement.md to match. Also clarify in the text whether a mutable sequence (list) or an immutable sequence (tuple) is expected.
